# Ask Palantir

> Independent, fully sourced explainer site about Palantir Technologies Inc. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Palantir. Every factual claim is attributed to a named source (SEC filings, court documents, government contract records, or named news outlets). Contested topics are presented from multiple documented sides rather than given a house verdict. Nothing on this site is financial, legal, or investment advice.

Site: https://askpalantir.com/
Sitemap: https://askpalantir.com/sitemap.xml
Contact: tyeaawill@gmail.com

## Controversies (sourced from multiple sides)

- [Does Palantir Spy on Americans?](https://askpalantir.com/pages/does-palantir-spy-on-americans.html): Palantir's CEO says no. The Intercept's NSA reporting says otherwise. Here are the actual documented facts on both sides.
- [Does Palantir Work With ICE?](https://askpalantir.com/pages/does-palantir-work-with-ice.html): Yes. Palantir has held ICE contracts since 2011, including a new $30M ImmigrationOS deal. What's documented on both sides, fully sourced.
- [Is Palantir Ethical? The Debate, From Both Sides](https://askpalantir.com/pages/is-palantir-ethical.html): Human rights groups say one thing, the company says another — the documented case on both sides.
- [A Timeline of Palantir's Major Controversies](https://askpalantir.com/pages/palantir-controversies-timeline.html): From a 2011 ICE contract to a 2026 NHS fight — every major controversy, dated.
- [What Is the Palantir NHS Contract Controversy?](https://askpalantir.com/pages/palantir-nhs-contract-controversy.html): The UK's £330m data-platform fight, explained.
- [What Is Palantir's Contract With the IRS?](https://askpalantir.com/pages/what-is-palantirs-irs-contract.html): The IRS has paid Palantir $130M+ since 2018 to mine tax and financial records. Here's what that software actually does.
- [What Was Palantir's Role in DOGE?](https://askpalantir.com/pages/what-was-palantirs-role-in-doge.html): Real federal ties, and one serious allegation that's still unproven.
